title: SKE Crystal Lemon & Lime Nic Salt E-Liquid 10ml
description: Lemon & Lime flavour from SKE Crystal Nic Salts e-liquid evokes a sharp and refreshing taste of freshly squeezed citrus fruits. This vibrant blend combines the sour tartness of lemon with the sunny zest of juicy lime, providing a sweet, sharp experience that's perfect for day-long enjoyment. This e-liquid's balanced 50VG/50PG ratio ensures great flavour and vapour production, making it suitable for a variety of MTL vaping setups. The use of nicotine salts enhances the smoothness of each inhale, making it ideal for vapers seeking a gentle throat hit and those transitioning from smoking. SKE are the creators of the hugely popular SKE Crystal Bar 600 disposable vape, a super-convenient single-use vape bar encased in a dazzling crystal chassis. SKE have since expanded their range with the SKE Crystal Plus pre-filled pod kit as well as this ever-evolving collection of Nicotine Salt 10ml e-liquids for use with many kinds of vape kit.
